heading: Today
text: Showers becoming a steady rain, briefly moderate to heavy from the Adirondacks and I-89 north, with some morning showers south, numerous this afternoon.  Highs in the 40s and low 50s east and north of I-89, upper 50s and low 60s west and south.  Winds south to southeast 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Rain and showers north, scattered south, diminishing west to east.  Lows in the 40s north, 50s south.  Winds south to southeast 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, shifting to the southwest and west, late in NH.

heading: Wednesday
text: Mostly cloudy, with a stray shower or two north, mostly across the higher terrain.  A stray morning shower south, then clouds breaking for some sun in southern valleys.  Highs in the 50s north, 60s south.  Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph.
